continuous_text.title: What Are You Wearing?
continuous_text.content:
What are you wearing?
I'm wearing a T-shirt.
What are you wearing?
I'm wearing a skirt.

What's he wearing?
He's wearing new shorts.
What's he wearing?
He's wearing old boots.

What's she wearing?
She's wearing a red hat.
What's she wearing?
She's wearing pink shoes.

continuous_text.title: My Favorite Hat!
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1:
Patrick: What are you wearing?
Frame 2:
Jane: I'm wearing a green hat. It's my favorite hat.
Frame 3:
Patrick: What's Tim wearing?
Jane: He's wearing a brown hat. It's his favorite hat.
Frame 4:
Patrick: What's Maria wearing?
Jane: She's wearing a purple hat. It's her favorite hat.
Frame 5:
Maria: What are you wearing, Patrick?
Frame 6:
Patrick: I'm wearing a funny hat! It's my favorite hat!
continuous_text.notes: Frames 1-4 on p. 66; frames 5-6 on p. 67; track 108

continuous_text.title: Content Connection: Weather and Clothes
continuous_text.content: The weather isn't the same everywhere. It's very cold in the mountains. It isn't hot. He's wearing his hat and gloves. It's very hot and dry in the desert. It isn't cold. She's wearing her shorts and hat. It's wet in the jungle. He's wearing his jacket and boots.

continuous_text.title: Grammar Reading: Birthday Ages
continuous_text.content: Today is my birthday. I'm nine. Jenny is my sister. She's five. She's a little girl. I have a baby brother. He's one. Johnny is my best friend. He's nine, too! My grandparents are 70. They're very old!

continuous_text.title: Culture Connection: Funny Hats!
continuous_text.content:
1 This is Ascot. It's in England. Many people go and watch the horse races. They also look at the hats women have.
2 Some hats are very big and have many colors. Red, blue, yellow, and green.
3 Some hats have very big flowers or long feathers. They're beautiful.
4 There are some very funny hats, too. They have birds, horses, teacups, and umbrellas on them! Do you wear funny hats?

continuous_text.title: Phonics Chant (o, k, ck)
continuous_text.content:
Put on your socks,
Put on your shorts.
Kick the ball,
Kick, kick, kick!

curriculum_components.title: My Favorite Clothes
curriculum_components.description: Vocabulary presentation for 13 items of everyday clothing.

curriculum_components.title: What Are You Wearing?
curriculum_components.description: Chant practicing questions and descriptions of clothes being worn.

curriculum_components.title: My Favorite Hat!
curriculum_components.description: Humorous comic narrative describing what friends are wearing on their heads.

curriculum_components.title: What are you / he wearing?
curriculum_components.description: Present continuous questions and answers with clothing.

curriculum_components.title: Weather and clothing
curriculum_components.description: Connecting appropriate clothing items with climates and environments.

curriculum_components.title: Clothes poster
curriculum_components.description: Making and presenting a poster connecting clothing and weather.

curriculum_components.title: How old are you / he / she / they?
curriculum_components.description: Asking and answering questions about age with pronoun concord.

curriculum_components.title: Funny Hats!
curriculum_components.description: Cultural tradition of elaborate and unusual hats at Royal Ascot in England.

curriculum_components.title: Respect all cultures.
curriculum_components.description: Appreciating traditional cultural clothing from Guatemala, the Philippines, and Kenya.

curriculum_components.title: o, k, ck
curriculum_components.description: Letter-sound relationships and word blending for /ɒ/ and /k/ (k, ck).

curriculum_components.title: Review
curriculum_components.description: Review and self-assessment of clothes, present continuous, and age.
